name.ja: ＨＧ 1/144 フルアーマーガンダム

description.ja: “ ガ ン ダ ム ” の 攻 撃 ・ 防 御 力 向 上 プ ラ ン ―ＦＳＷＳ―
description.en: “Gundam” attack/defense improvement plan -FSWS-

description.ja: 『機動戦士ガンダム』ＭＳＤ（Ｍｏｂｉｌｅ Ｓｕｉｔ Ｄｉｓｃｏｖｅｒｙ）より、
description.en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam" MSD (Mobile Suit Discovery),

description.ja: 地球連邦軍のFSWSによって開発されたといわれるフルアーマーガンダムがＨＧキットで登場。
description.en: The full armor Gundam, said to have been developed by the Earth Federation's FSWS, is now available in HGKit.

description.ja: 各種武装と装甲パーツ類を新規造形で立体化。特徴的なグリーンを基調とした機体カラーパターンは素体のRX-78を含め成形色で再現。
description.en: Various weapons and armor parts are three-dimensionalized with new modeling. The distinctive green-based aircraft color pattern is reproduced in molding color, including the base RX-78.

description.ja: 新規デザインを含む水転写式デカールが付属。
description.en: Includes water transfer decals including new designs.

description.ja: ●　各部増加装甲＆ＭＳＤ版のカラーパターンを新規造形で再現
description.en: ● Reproduce the color pattern of each part increased armor & MSD version with new modeling

description.ja: 全身に及ぶ各部増加装甲を新規造形で再現。ＭＳＤ版の機体カラーリングを素体となるRX-78含め成形色で再現。
description.en: The increased armor of each part of the whole body is reproduced with new modeling. The MSD version's aircraft coloring is reproduced with molding colors, including the base RX-78.

description.ja: 胸部ダクト、腹部装甲や脚部サブ・スラスターなど、細部に至るまで形状を再現。
description.en: The shape is reproduced down to the smallest detail, including the chest duct, abdominal armor, and leg sub-thrusters.

description.ja: ●　ＭＳＤ版の機体カラーリングを素体となるRX-78含め成形色で再現。
description.en: ● The MSD version's aircraft coloring is reproduced with molding colors, including the base RX-78.

description.ja: 素体となるRX-78はそのままに各部装甲類、左腕部小型シールドの着脱が可能。
description.en: The main body of RX-78 can be attached and detached with armor and a small seal on the left arm.

description.ja: ●　各種武装とそのギミックを新規造形で再現
description.en: ● Reproduce various weapons and their gimmicks with new modeling

description.ja: キャノン砲（360mmロケット砲）、２連装ビーム・ガン、ミサイル・ベイなど各種武装の形状とギミックを新規造形で再現。
description.en: The shapes and gimmicks of various weapons such as the cannon (360mm rocket), double beam gun, and missile bay are reproduced with new modeling.

description.ja: キャノン砲（360mmロケット砲）
description.en: Cannon (360mm rocket gun)

description.ja: 右背部のキャノン砲は上下に可動する。左側のセンサーユニットも精密に再現。
description.en: The cannon on the right back can move up and down. The sensor unit on the left side is also precisely reproduced.

description.ja: ２連装ビーム・ガン
description.en: double beam gun

description.ja: 右腕部へ装着する２連装ビーム・ガンは砲身部分まで精密に再現。
description.en: The double beam gun attached to the right arm is precisely reproduced down to the gun barrel.

description.ja: ミサイル・ベイ
description.en: missile bay

description.ja: 胸部の両肩口、両膝部に設けられたミサイル・ベイはハッチの開閉ギミックを搭載。
description.en: The missile bays located on both shoulders and knees of the chest are equipped with a hatch opening and closing gimmick.

description.ja: 内部ミサイルの形状も細やかに再現。
description.en: The shape of the internal missile is also reproduced in detail.

description.ja: ●　MSDをイメージした肩部や腰部のラインマークや、連邦マーク、ナンバーマークなどを収録した専用の水転写式デカールが付属。
description.en: ● Comes with a special water transfer decal that includes MSD-inspired line marks on the shoulders and waist, federal mark, number mark, etc.

description.ja: ●　HG ガンダム(GUNDAM THE ORIGIN版)の可動性能により装甲を装着したまま大胆なアクションポーズが可能。
description.en: ● The movable performance of HG Gundam (GUNDAM THE ORIGIN version) allows for bold action poses while wearing armor.

description.ja: 付属武装：キャノン砲（360mmロケット砲） ／ ミサイル・ベイ ／ ２連装ビーム・ガン
description.en: Attached armament: Cannon (360mm rocket cannon) / Missile bay / Dual beam gun

description.en: 1/144 Scale Assembly plastic model
